This document outlines the 
testing procedure P1, which must be performed every 6 months as indicated by M6 in the above title block.

This patent concerns the 
test of protection relays of the exciter 
manufactured by SKODA PLZEN. 
The exciter 
is of type HE500630/2, rated active power 1210KW, rated apparent power 
2200KVA, stator nominal voltage 525V, and rated field current 190A .

The first draft initiated 
 by eng .Maysa Ahmady, tested at 27 Jan. 2003 by eng. Iman Rizk ElAshry, reviewed by quality control 
 engineer eng. Adel Abd El Kader EL Nagar of EDEPCo, accepted by general 
 director eng . Mahmoud El Saied Sakr, and approved by eng. Mohamed Reda Abdel 
 Azez Soliman Pre. Sector Head of Talkha PS 2x210 MW.

 panels.

Disconnect the trip leads of the relay and

Connect the voltmeter in 
 parallel with the voltage leads of Z11 ( the other unit ) to measure the 
 voltage.

Repeat the test with 220 Va.c to terminals

Supply 220 Vdc between 15 (-) & 16(+) 
 . Supply an AC voltage of 100 V to terminals 12 , 13.

Terminals 1,5 are disconnected. With

The alarm relay will fall into the

Protections | Technical Procedure
Introduction
This document outlines the 
testing procedure P1, which must be performed every 6 months as indicated by M6 in the above title block.
This patent concerns the 
test of protection relays of the exciter 
manufactured by SKODA PLZEN. 
The exciter 
is of type HE500630/2, rated active power 1210KW, rated apparent power 
2200KVA, stator nominal voltage 525V, and rated field current 190A .
The first draft initiated 
 by eng .Maysa Ahmady, tested at 27 Jan. 2003 by eng. Iman Rizk ElAshry, reviewed by quality control 
 engineer eng. Adel Abd El Kader EL Nagar of EDEPCo, accepted by general 
 director eng . Mahmoud El Saied Sakr, and approved by eng. Mohamed Reda Abdel 
 Azez Soliman Pre. Sector Head of Talkha PS 2x210 MW.
Safety Precautions
A work permit 
must be issued and the qualified maintenance staff should carry the suitable 
safely category
Safety fence 
(rope) with caution marks and No Smoking sign surrounding the work area must be used.
Wearing safety 
helmet, shoes, masks are necessary.
Ascertain the disconnection of the exciter, the generator, main 
transform, and home transformer .
Be aware of parts in service.
Follow the work permission instructions.
Tools and Equipment
An A.C. voltage source of type Z11.
An A.C. current source of type Z11.
Varying - Resistance Box .
An ammeter & A voltmeter.
A timer unit TM-2 ( Program )
Some leads & screws.
Work to be Carried Out
Preparation of Relays
Review the manual.
Prepare the previous results of the relay 
 testing.
Check the wires of the relay beforehand.
Be sure that the unit and the transformer are 
 disconnected and the DC source is available.
Check the existence of the d.c. sources in 
 panels.
Disconnect the trip leads of the relay and 
 connect the timer to them.
Check all the leads used in tests
Preparation of Testing Tools
Connect the testing units of Z11 to a power 
 source.
Connect the timer to a power source and its 
 terminals to the trip terminals of the relay under test.
Place an ammeter on current leads of Z11 to 
 measure the current.
Connect the voltmeter in 
 parallel with the voltage leads of Z11 ( the other unit ) to measure the 
 voltage.
Differential of exciter type R32X1
It is a three point differential protection with 
the measuring member in each phase, locked switching on surge.
C.T. TA12 & TA14 2500/5A
Test steps
Inject the current in points ( 11,12,13,14N ) 
 of Z13 either ph-ph or ph-N
Or inject the current in points ( 11,12,13 ) 
 of Z14 ph-ph.
Place a socket ZZ10 in Z13 (TA12), and another 
 one in Z14 (TA14).
Fix the timer leads in (172,188) at the rear 
 of panel HH03.
Or inject the current in terminal (14(N)) of 
 Z13, and (11,12,13)(phase) of Z14.
Increase the injected current gradually till 
 the red flag of the device displays. Let the timer start acting till it stops 
 (almost instantaneously)
Record the results in each case of injection.
Over Current type A33TX1
It is a three 
phase over- current protection with a distinguishing of the effected phases, and 
a time member.
C.T. TA13 2500/5A
Test Steps
Place the socket ZZ10 in Z11 (HH01).
Fix the timer leads in (172,199) at the rear 
 of panel HH02.
Inject the current in points 
 (11,14),(12,14),(13,14(N))of Z11 respectively phase-N .
Increase the injected current gradually till 
 the red flag of the device displays.
Let the timer start acting till it stops (its 
 red flag displays) indicating the tripping time of the device.
Repeat the steps for each phase.
Record the results.
Over Load type A3TX1
It is a three phase over- current protection 
without distinguishing of the effected phases with a time member.
C.T. TA13 2500/5A
Test Steps
Place the socket ZZ10 in Z11 (HH01).
Fix the timer leads in (172,197) at the rear 
 of panel HH04.
Inject the current to points (11,14) then 
 (12,14), and finally (13,14(N)) of Z11 ph-N.
Increase the injected current gradually till 
 the red flag of the device displays.
Let the timer start acting till it stops (its

Repeat the steps for each phase.

G2 Rotor insulating condition checking

 Supply an a.c. voltage of 100V to terminals 12,13 .
A 750 V will be measured on C4 then with " IZOL. G2 " pressed down.
Connect resistance R = 68 kW ( by a resistance box) to terminal 1{ ground } and 4. With " Isolation

 state / within about 3 sec .
Repeat the test with 220 Va.c to terminals 
 12,14 .
G2 Generator earth connection test
Supply 220 Vdc between 15 (-) & 16(+) 
 . Supply an AC voltage of 100 V to terminals 12 , 13.
Terminals 1,5 are disconnected. With 
 the press of " TestG2" push button, the B, 1B relays, J reed relay, C,D 
 relays will close.
The alarm relay will fall into the 
 red flag and the 1B relay has about 2 sec slow release.
Connect terminal 1{ground}& 5 
 through resistance about 220 ohm The D relay closes with voltage lower than 
 50V. Check that contact on terminals 6 - 7 & 8 - 9 closes.
Press down the Reset push button then 
 the white flag displays again. + 220 V on terminal 11, the B, 1B,J,C, and D 
 relays will start operating. The NG2 magnetic indicator will start operating. 
 Circuits of contacts on terminals 6-7 , 8-9 are opened . With + 220V 
 connection to terminal 10, the magnetic indicator will release.
Testing of exciting of terminals 12-14
Supply an a.c. voltage of 100V to 
terminals (12,13) and measure by a voltmeter the existence of 220 V on terminals 
(12,14)

( 2nd unit 210MW ) type ALOX 
GR100

protection with DC superposition.
Test steps
Check the existence of the dc voltage ( 220 Vdc 
 ).
Fulfill the self test of the device.
Place the leads of the varying-resistance box 
 on terminals (3,5) at the rear of panel hh06
Decrease the value of resistance gradually till 
 the red lamp indicating both the first stage (R <) and the relay signal - 
 switches on.
Keep on decreasing the resistance till the 
 red lamp indicating both the second stage (R<</t) and the relay tripping 
 value - switches on.
Record the value of the resistance for the two 
 stages & compare them with the previous ones.
Pro Maintenance 
Procedures
Loosen the leads of the testing 
 instruments.
Check the return of relay- wires and

Press the main RESET button in 
 HH01.
Be sure that the relay is completely

 equipments in addition to the caution signs and leave the place clean.
Return the work permission.
